comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Finance confirmed the CSV columns on a dry run. Closing.

content.text: Finance confirmed the CSV columns on a dry run. Closing.
Finance wants CSAT responses for the previous billing quarter exported as CSV for the board pack. Today agents can only screenshot dashboards or page through the UI.

Done: an export job on the CSAT admin page filtered by response_submitted_at within the selected quarter, columns for ticket_id, score, comment, queue, and billing_account_id, delivered as a downloadable CSV and optionally emailed to the requester. Verified against Q1 fixture data (1,042 rows) matching the dashboard aggregate.
